[[File:Corsec_database.jpg|thumb|CorSec Database [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]].]]
The '''CorSec criminal database''' was a database containing information on various criminals operating in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that was maintained by the [[Corellian Security Force]]. [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Shepprd Barron]] provided information from the database on the [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]] "[[Gundark (arms dealer)|Gundark]]" to [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Drev Prilarca]] of the [[New Republic Security Force]].<ref name="GFTPG">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
